apple_health.title: Health
apple_health.description: Data imported into this Miroir connection. Blank values mean no imported measurement. Charts show the available history; the tables show recent imported records.

charts.name: Steps per day
charts.query: select day, steps from {health}.daily_summary order by day

charts.name: Sleep per night (hours)
charts.query: select day, sleep_h from {health}.daily_summary order by day

charts.name: Resting heart rate (bpm)
charts.query: select day, resting_hr from {health}.daily_summary order by day

charts.name: Heart rate variability (ms)
charts.query: select day, hrv_ms from {health}.daily_summary order by day

charts.name: Active energy per day (kcal)
charts.query: select day, active_kcal from {health}.daily_summary order by day

charts.name: Imported days
charts.query: select min(day) as first_day, max(day) as latest_day, count(*) as days, count(steps) as days_with_steps, count(sleep_h) as days_with_sleep from {health}.daily_summary

charts.name: Recent daily summaries
charts.query: select day, steps, active_kcal, sleep_h, resting_hr, hrv_ms from {health}.daily_summary order by day desc limit 30

charts.name: Recent workouts
charts.query: select started_at, workout_type, duration_min, distance_km, avg_hr from {health}.workout_summary order by started_at desc limit 100

listenbrainz.title: Music
listenbrainz.description: Data imported into this Miroir connection. Dates and hours use the connection's analysis timezone. Charts show the available history; the tables show recent imported records.

charts.name: Listens per day
charts.query: select day, listens from {music}.daily order by day

charts.name: New artists per day
charts.query: select day, new_artists from {music}.daily order by day

charts.name: Monthly favorites
charts.query: select month, top_artist, top_track, listens from {music}.monthly_top order by month desc

charts.name: Most played artists
charts.query: select artist, plays, tracks, first_listen, last_listen from {music}.artists order by plays desc limit 30

charts.name: Recent listening sessions
charts.query: select started_at, tracks, minutes, top_artist from {music}.sessions order by started_at desc limit 100

charts.name: Recent listens
charts.query: select started_at, artist, track, album, service from {music}.listens order by started_at desc limit 100
